Name: Cabins to Farmhouses
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- Cabins are now Farmhouses
- Mods for Farmhouses will work with these, provided the mod author has added compatibility in their mod code.
- When fully upgraded these new Farmhouses can be painted just like regular Farmhouses
- The mailbox is now separate and off the porch and can be changed with Content Patcher
- Unique cabin skins thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5881065]windvalley[/url]! They created all but the Trailer cabin, which I did myself.
- Adds another cabin skin called "Default" for those who prefer the look of the vanilla farmhouse
[size=4]
[/size][size=5]FAQ: (Please read this before asking a question!)[/size][b]

Q: Who should have this mod installed?

[/b]A: When playing multiplayer, the host and all farmhands need to have this mod installed.[b]

[/b]--[b]

Q: Is this mod compatible with *insert building mod here*?[/b]

A: Building mods will be need to be made compatible by mod authors, which will take some time. Any that do not current have compatibility in their coding can be made compatible manually. Please read this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2248]Article[/url] explaining how to do so.

--
[b]
Q: Is this mod compatible with Alternative Textures?[/b]

A: Since this mod changes the image size of the cabins, AT textures for the vanilla cabin types will not work unless made specifically for this mod. However, you can use the AT Paint Bucket to change cabin skins.

--

[b]Q: Do mods that change the appearances of mailboxes work with this?[/b]

A: Yes! However Alternative Textures doesn't support cabin mailboxes, so any changes to farmhand mailboxes will need to be made with Content Patcher.

[size=5]Known Issues:
[/size]
- The mail bubble for farmhands is offset by one tile to the left. This appears to be hardcoded into the game and not something I can fix.

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Cabins to Farmhouses into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
